messages:
Jen: Heads-up, docs CI failing on my PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412). Linkcheck + vale + md-lint. Can someone help triage?
Tia: :eyes: I can take a first pass. Which failures are you seeing in the preview?
Jen: Preview bot posted errors, but the CI log has multiple. Short summary: 1) linkcheck failing on renamed anchor in migration guide 2) vale complaining about 'nominally' in quickstart 3) md-lint line-length and code fence spacing in SDK snippet 4) spellcheck flagged 'envrionment' in private-deploy.md
Sam: pinging @mike for the anchor — he moved the section last week.
Mike: yup that was me, moved the 'VPC networking' header. Link probably needs the new slug. I can update the anchor in the migration guide, or we can make linkcheck accept the redirect. Which file references it?
Jen: docs/guides/migrations/vpc-migration.md references docs/setup/private#vpc-networking (old anchor).
Tia: I can push a tiny patch with three hunks: fix anchor, correct spelling, and adjust SDK code fence indentation. Want me to open a follow-up PR or just force-push to the branch?
Jen: follow-up PR preferred so CI runs separately. I'll add you as reviewer.
Sam: For vale, what's the exact rule? If it's a style rule we shouldn't change copy arbitrarily.
Jen: vale output: "S4: Use simpler wording; 'nominally' flagged as formal."
Tia: propose change: replace "nominally" -> "generally" in quickstart, then ping content team for approval.
Mike: ok. For linkcheck I can add a redirect entry in the anchor map, but simpler to update the link target to the new header. I'll do that in my patch.
doc-bot: CI preview failed for PR 412 — linkcheck: 1 error, vale: 1 warning, md-lint: 2 errors, spellcheck: 1 error. See <preview:staging/412>.
Tia: I'll create PR 413 with fixes. Command I plan to run locally: 
```
./bin/docs-lint --fix --files docs/guides/migrations/vpc-migration.md docs/quickstart.md docs/setup/private-deploy.md docs/snippets/sdk-inits.md
```
Jen: looks good. Make sure to run `npx vale --output=summary` before pushing so we can see the warnings.
Tia: will do. Also will add a short PR body listing each CI item fixed + screenshots of local preview.
Sam: I can review 413 this afternoon. If it greenlights, please don't squash so we can keep individual fixes separate (anchor vs wording vs snippet).
Jen: small note — MD line-length: it's the long JS example in sdk-inits snippet; we should break the line and show `// eslint-disable-next-line max-len`? prefer not. Better to wrap string concatenation on multiple lines.
Mike: agree, wrap. I can propose the change in a quick commit.
Tia: PR 413 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/413 — includes three commits: anchor-fix, spell-fix, snippet-wrap. Asking @sam and @mike for review.
preview-bot: Preview build queued for PR 413. Build URL: <preview:staging/413>
Sam: quick look: anchor fix LGTM. Two tiny comments on snippet whitespace.
Tia: addressed both, pushed commit 2.
preview-bot: Preview build complete — warnings: vale (1) — please check suggestions. Linkcheck: pass. md-lint: pass. Spellcheck: pass.
Jen: great, looks like vale is only a suggestion now. Sam — you ok to approve?
Sam: approve from me. :shipit:
Jen: thanks everyone! I'll merge after CI final green. If preview-bot throws anything else I'll revert and re-triage.
Mike: small follow-up: I'll update the migration guide anchor map in the next cleanup pass, but this patch is fine.
Jen: merging now.
doc-bot: PR 413 merged by jen — deployed preview removed. Release note: docs: fix link anchor, spelling, and SDK snippet formatting. :tada:
